# Pups & Vines

Pups & Vines (pupsandvines.com) is a curated directory of dog-friendly wineries in Napa Valley and Sonoma County, paired with editorial guides for dog owners who want to explore wine country with their pets.

## Site sections

- Homepage: https://pupsandvines.com/
- Winery directory (all dog-friendly listings): https://pupsandvines.com/directory
- Interactive map of dog-friendly wineries: https://pupsandvines.com/map
- Blog (tips, guides, gear reviews): https://pupsandvines.com/blog
- About: https://pupsandvines.com/about
